purpose: Convert existing DreamLedger capability into independently verified earning units, then integrate only proven units.
optimization_loop: INVENTORY existing offers and actual fulfillment workers
SELECT one offer with a concrete buyer problem and zero-cost test path
DEFINE inputs, output schema, acceptance criteria, refusal cases, evidence and turnaround
PROBE live dependencies read-only; stale or unreachable capability fails closed
TEST locally or with non-paying fixtures, labelled TEST and excluded from revenue truth
GAUNTLET-check security, scope, attribution, unit economics, fulfillment and failure recovery
HUMAN-GATE public listing, outreach, live financial action and irreversible publication
OBSERVE genuine external transaction only after authorization
RECONCILE payment, order, entitlement, fulfillment, artifact hash and independent evidence
PROMOTE only after verified outcome; otherwise record exact failure and smallest repair

selection_score.rule: Use as a comparison aid, not a substitute for hard gates. Any missing fulfillment path, unclear authorization, unsafe payment boundary or unverifiable outcome blocks activation.

initial_candidates.reason: Live quote-intake and quote-fulfillment functions identified; output artifacts are HTML and CSV.
blockers: atomic checkout/order idempotency not yet proven
real end-to-end acceptance contract and evidence chain need read-only verification

initial_candidates.reason: Existing offer and Truth Oracle/evidence capabilities may support a bounded evidence receipt.
blockers: actual worker and input/output contract must be verified
sources, verdict limits and independent evidence must be defined

sunrise_integration_rule.merge: Only proven earning units and their reusable contracts, tests, evidence adapters and failure handling.
integration_order: replication of a unit only after independent verified transaction

hard_boundaries: No fake buyers, payments, evidence, or outcomes
No external outreach or publication without explicit authorization
No payment acceptance when fulfillment is not currently proven
No promotion from TEST or UNVERIFIED to VERIFIED without independent evidence
